title: Jazz Jam @ Red Light Cafe
event_description: Weekly jazz jam led by the Gordon Vernick Quartet. Professional and amateur musicians welcome to sit in and perform. One of Atlanta's longest-running jazz sessions in an intimate listening room.
event_venue_information:
About Red Light Cafe

Red Light Cafe is Atlanta's premiere listening room for Americana Bluegrass Country & Western Folk Blues Jazz Roots Rock and everything in between. Located on the east side of Piedmont Park in Midtown Atlanta's Amsterdam Walk this cozy venue features tables and seating for over 100 guests.

Music Programming

The venue hosts diverse weekly programming including the Wednesday Jazz Jam with Gordon Vernick Quartet comedy open mics on the first Tuesday storytelling open mics on the third Tuesday and regular burlesque shows. The venue also presents touring national acts across multiple genres.

Venue Details

Full bar and kitchen available. Doors open at 8 PM for the jazz jam. $10 door admission ($5 for performers or students with ID). The venue maintains a listening room atmosphere where music receives focused attention. Livestreamed on YouTube.com/RedLightCafe.

title: Jazz Jam @ Napoleon's
event_description: Weekly jazz jam session led by trumpeter Joe Gransden with house band. All skill levels welcome from age 10 to 90s. Relaxed no-pressure atmosphere focused on networking and musical growth.
event_venue_information:
About Napoleon's

Napoleon's Grill in Decatur hosts one of Atlanta's longest-running and most respected jazz jam sessions. The venue is a full-service restaurant and bar that has become a cornerstone of the metro Atlanta jazz community.

Music Programming

In addition to the Monday night jazz jam led by Joe Gransden Napoleon's hosts Blues Jam Sessions with Sandra Senn and Blue Velvet Atlanta on the 2nd and 4th Thursday of each month (7:30-10:00 PM). The venue also features an Acoustic Open Mic on the 2nd and 4th Tuesday with Bill Sheffield and Spencer L. Kirkpatrick.

The Gransden Legacy

Joe Gransden is a renowned trumpeter and vocalist who leads a 16-piece big band. His jam sessions have been running for years previously at Twain's Brewpub before moving to Napoleon's. The sessions attract musicians from throughout the region and occasionally draw visiting artists.

title: Blues Jam @ Napoleon's
event_description: Blues jam session hosted by Sandra Senn and Blue Velvet Atlanta. Bring your instrument to showcase your talent. Dancing jamming and supportive atmosphere.
event_venue_information:
About Napoleon's

Napoleon's Grill in Decatur hosts one of Atlanta's longest-running and most respected jam sessions. The venue is a full-service restaurant and bar.

Music Programming

Napoleon's features multiple weekly jam sessions: Monday night jazz with Joe Gransden (7:30-10:00 PM) Blues Jam on 2nd and 4th Thursdays with Sandra Senn and Acoustic Open Mic on 2nd and 4th Tuesdays with Bill Sheffield and Spencer L. Kirkpatrick.

title: Acoustic Open Mic @ Napoleon's
event_description: Acoustic open mic featuring renowned musicians Bill Sheffield and Spencer L. Kirkpatrick. Open to singers songwriters and instrumentalists. Each artist performs two songs (10 minutes total).
hosts: Bill Sheffield and Spencer L. Kirkpatrick
backline: No amplifiers laptops or loopers - acoustic only
event_venue_information:
About Napoleon's

Napoleon's Grill in Decatur is a full-service restaurant featuring regular music programming throughout the week.

Open Mic Details

This acoustic-focused open mic does not allow amplifiers laptops or loopers. Musicians must bring their own instruments as none are provided. Each performer gets approximately 10 minutes total (2 songs). Open to original songs or covers.

title: Songwriters Open Mic @ Eddie's Attic
event_description: Atlanta's premiere songwriters open mic running for over 20 years. National and local acts perform 2 songs each with 3 finalists competing for cash prize and spot in bi-annual Open Mic Shootout.
event_venue_information:
About Eddie's Attic

Eddie's Attic has been Atlanta's most respected listening room since 1991. The venue launched the careers of John Mayer Shawn Mullins Jennifer Nettles (Sugarland) Clay Cook The Civil Wars Luke Combs and many others.

The Open Mic Shootout

Twice yearly Eddie's hosts the legendary Open Mic Shootout - a competition that has been running for over 27 years. Winners have included John Mayer Tyler Childers Clay Cook Victoria Canal and Jennifer Nettles among others. The shootout provides exposure to music industry professionals and avid fans.

Venue Details

Intimate listening room atmosphere. Full bar and kitchen open until 10 PM. Last artist goes on stage at 10:30 PM. The venue features a wide range of musical acts year-round from up-and-comers to Grammy winners across multiple genres.

title: Jazz Jam @ The Waiting Room
event_description: Tuesday night jazz jam in intimate upstairs speakeasy above Bon Ton restaurant. Features Dallas Dawson's trio plus guests weaving through jazz tunes in 70s-themed atmosphere.
event_venue_information:
About The Waiting Room

The Waiting Room is an intimate upstairs cocktail bar located above Bon Ton Vietnamese/Cajun fusion restaurant in Midtown. The space features 70s-inspired decor with orange shag carpeting mirrors and a disco ball creating an atmosphere reminiscent of A Clockwork Orange's Korova Milk Bar.

Ambiance

The space features red decor and lighting curved booths with shaggy orange fur seats and specialty cocktails. Very intimate setting perfect for jazz. $7 entertainment fee on jazz nights. Specialty cocktails including absinthe Hurricane and strong drinks.

Access

Enter through Bon Ton's front door ignore the hostess stand and head up the dark staircase. Small parking lot available. Can order from Bon Ton's Cajun-Vietnamese menu downstairs though space is tight for full meals.

title: Jazz Jam @ TEN ATL
event_description: Monday night jazz jam session continuing the Churchill Grounds legacy. Features Churchill Grounds Trio with Larry Willson (drums/host) Kenny Banks Jr. (piano) and Joel Powell (bass).
venue_address: 495 Flat Shoals Avenue Southeast Atlanta GA 30316
hosts: Churchill Grounds Trio: Larry Willson Kenny Banks Jr. Joel Powell
sign_up: In Person with host at venue
event_venue_information:
About TEN ATL

TEN ATL in East Atlanta Village carries forward the legacy of Churchill Grounds which for nearly two decades was the heart of Atlanta's jazz scene next to the Fox Theatre. After Churchill Grounds' owner Sam Yi passed away in February 2025 the Churchill Grounds Trio relocated the beloved Monday night jam to TEN ATL.

The Churchill Grounds Legacy

Churchill Grounds was Atlanta's premier jazz bar presenting music five nights a week and occasionally hosting drop-ins from touring musicians like Wynton Marsalis and Lady Gaga. The Monday night jam session maintains the same vibe and commitment to keeping jazz alive.

Venue Details

TEN ATL opens at 8 PM with the jazz jam starting at 10 PM. Musicians and vocalists welcome - sign in with host upon arrival. Musicians/vocalists pay $5 at door with no guaranteed seating. All other seating starts at $35. Food available from local restaurants. The venue also features DJ nights blues performances and funk/soul parties on other nights.
